voss.prompt:
Create a production game HUD sprite sheet of TEN separate finished UI plates on genuine transparent alpha. Theme: scratched antique bronze and dark iron, layered ragged crimson cloth, restrained tiny skull and ammunition motifs, strong angular blades. Match the ornate fantasy painted game UI references, rich material detail and sharp carved borders, premium finished readable HUD assets. No presentation, background scene, captions or annotations. Orthographic front-on flat sprites.
Arrange precisely TWO equal columns and FIVE equal rows, lots of transparent space between pieces, each plate same horizontal 4:1 footprint, no touching. Every plate is a complete closed frame with a dark black stone/leather inset. Gold serif letters integrated into the artwork, beautifully balanced, legible at HUD size.
Read order row 1 left "MARA VOSS", right "KAEL"; row 2 left "VESPER", right "IONA"; row 3 left "ORIN", right "NAGASH". These SIX name plaques have centered exact lettering, independently designed frames balanced to the name, consistent outer footprint. No portraits.
Row 4 left AMBER counter plate: tiny themed amber emblem occupying LEFT 12%, absolutely EMPTY dark number space from 18% to 64% of width reserved for runtime large numeric value, exact baked word "AMBER" occupying RIGHT 27%. Row 4 right BACKPACK: small themed backpack emblem LEFT and exact centered "BACKPACK" lettering.
Row 5 left RELICS: small themed relic emblem LEFT and exact centered "RELICS" lettering. Row 5 right RE-ROLLS: small die emblem LEFT 12%, exact "RE-ROLLS" lettering between 20% and 69% width, absolutely EMPTY dark area RIGHT 22% reserved for runtime two-digit count.
Bake only the specified words. NO numbers on any plate. NO extra text. Consistent footprint but each frame has purposeful distinct ornament. Keep lettering and reserved empty numeric regions unobstructed by ornaments. Preserve genuine alpha outside sprite shapes, no checkerboard. High resolution sheet wide landscape ratio, artwork fills sheet with ten evenly spaced horizontal plaques.
